ideal_closed_loop: STEP 1: prediction generated (v40_2_daily_generator / maestro) → writes to predictions table

STEP 2: daily_closer.close_prediction() runs daily (Sun-Thu 12:35 UTC) → finds pending predictions, evaluates price history, marks closed as TARGET_HIT/STOPPED/EXPIRED with outcome_date + actual_return + hit_target + hit_stop
STEP 3: inside _mark_closed → calls lesson_store.record_lesson_from_close() → writes 2 rows to predictions.db.learned_lessons (prediction_outcome + ticker_outcome)
STEP 3b (optional): if STOPPED → calls prediction_tracker.learn_from_failure() → SHOULD write extra lesson row (BUT FAILS due to schema mismatch)
STEP 3c (optional): inside _mark_closed → calls trigger_immediate_learning() → does quick param tweaking into optimizer_params.json
STEP 4: daily_closer.run() end → calls utils.lesson_store.detect_and_record_missed_opportunities() → writes MISSED_BREAKOUT lessons

STEP 5: weekly on Friday 12:40 UTC → learning_engine.run() → reads closed predictions in last 90 days → analyzes signal_accuracy / by_market / by_confidence / by_regime / by_pattern → generates weight recommendations → writes to predictions.db.learned_lessons (different lesson_type values)

STEP 6: next prediction cycle → maestro_orchestrator.run_expert_memory_phase() reads learned_lessons via lesson_store.get_persona_lesson_summary() + get_ticker_lesson_summary() → applies bounded adjustments (caution/boost/stop_widen/target_raise) to predictions
STEP 7: V40.2 daily generator writes new predictions (but IGNORES lessons — break #5)
